hero.label: CASE FILES · DECLASSIFIED
hero.intro: Just the cases laid out, so you can judge. Unsolved mysteries, fantastic stories and cover-ups, told with real documents.

items.text: What do people say happened? You hear it the way its fans tell it.

books.label: THE BOOKS
books.headline: Go deeper than a *video* can
books.intro: Each case file starts as a book by {author}. The videos are the short version. The books hold the full story and the sources.
